asOf: Checked against Cisco's public exam, topics, course, and certification pages in October 2026. Prices and first-test dates are not copied into this lab. Re-open the live pages before you register or quote a date.

items.name: 300-830 CLCCE
items.status: Implementing Cisco Collaboration Cloud Customer Experience. The exam page describes a 90-minute English exam. Passing earns Cisco Certified Specialist - Collaboration Cloud Customer Experience and can meet a CCNP Collaboration concentration requirement, and it can count toward recertification. Topic weights on the Learning Network page fetched for this lab were 30%, 30%, 15%, and 25% across telephony and call routing, tenant configuration and reporting, digital channels, and advanced features and AI. Weights change. This lab does not store a price or a first-test date.

items.name: CCNP Collaboration
items.status: The parent professional certification. 300-830 can be used as a concentration exam. This lab does not invent a core exam number. Read the CCNP Collaboration page for the current list.

items.name: CLWXCALL
items.status: Essentials of Webex Calling is a training course. It is not the 300-830 exam and it does not by itself grant the specialist certification.

items.name: Program changes
items.status: Cisco publishes certification-program updates on the Learning Network. If a code on a slide disagrees with that page, the page wins.
